text: I'm so sorry to be botherin y'all this late, I'm the childminder for an 11 year old girl and her folks ain't back yet. Her temp is 37.6°C. She can't put her chin down to her chest, like she won't look down at her stomach at all, say it hurt and she just keep her head straight up. And her breathin been real fast, I can see it pullin in under her ribs every time she breathe and she makin this lil grunt sound. She been doin that for a minute now.
